MY LITTLE PET · LITTLEPET.IN

Installation & devices

Free for Windows — available now

  1. Visit the official itch.io page and choose the Free Windows download.
  2. Check the release requirements there. The current Windows build targets Windows 10/11, 64-bit, and includes its Python runtime.
  3. Open the installer, follow its prompts, then launch My Little Pet and enter your pet and owner names.

The Windows download is unsigned. Windows may warn about or block it. If installation is blocked, contact support; do not disable Windows security to install it.

Plus for Windows — coming soon

The Plus installer is not publicly available. Installation and compatibility checks are still in progress. It is planned to include both the pet room and desktop companion. The currently published Free installer does not contain the new Plus features.

Plus mobile room — coming soon

The planned phone version is an installable web app, not an APK, IPA or app-store release. It focuses on the pet room: feed, play, decorate and care for your friend. Rotate your phone horizontally for the landscape room. Pets stay inside the app; there is no phone desktop overlay.

When released, installation is planned through Chrome’s Install app / Add to Home screen on Android, or Safari’s Share → Add to Home Screen on iPhone. Menu names depend on browser version. Physical phone compatibility testing is still pending.

Offline play requires the first online setup to finish. Windows and mobile use separate saves. Export backups before clearing browser storage or changing devices.
